messages.subject: Re: Error in Data Reading
messages.body_plain:
Hi Zhongquan,

I am not sure if this is the problem, but it could be:

>From your error, it looks like the package "data.table" is masking the default "read.table" function that hBayesDM uses to read in the raw data. If you run "sessionInfo()", does the package "data.table" appear on the list? If so, you may need to ensure that it is not loaded in your environment before using hBayesDM.

Best,

Nate
From: hbayesd...@googlegroups.com <hbayesd...@googlegroups.com> on behalf of Zhongquan Li <zql...@gmail.com>
Sent: Monday, December 31, 2018 5:27:09 AM
To: hbayesdm-users
Subject: Error in Data Reading

Hello everyone.

Sorry to bother you.

We are conducting a study including the Choice Under Risk and Ambiguity Task(Levy et al., 2010), and trying to estimate risk attitude and ambiguity attitude parameters with the latest version of hBayesDM. However, we have a problem when running the code. Even if we run the sample code(one from the APS2017-workshop, see the attachment), the same problem occurred. We have tried many solutions, but none of them worked. So finally, we would like to turn to you for help.  Thanks a lot in advance.

The error message:

Error in data.table::fread(file = data, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", data.table = TRUE,  :

  unused argument (logical01 = FALSE)

Best regards.
Zhongquan
